meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 用户要求做幻灯片或演示时，Claude 会生成可导航的 HyperFrames 幻灯片 deck：含独立幻灯片、逐项显现、分支跳转、热点导航及带备注的演示模式；也可把现成页面转成 deck，而不是输出为 MP4 视频。
howto.when: 用户直接说要“幻灯片、slide show 或 HyperFrames slideshow”时触发；若只提到“presentation、pitch deck、把某页转成 deck”等，会先确认是否做 HyperFrames slideshow，同意后才开始。

say.text: 帮我把这份产品介绍做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片
say.note: Claude会生成可运行的deck，而非视频

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片版本，保留原有动效
say.note: Claude会把页面动效映射为幻灯片间的镜头过渡

say.text: 做一个带分支热点的10页 pitch deck
say.note: 生成带热点和分支线路的可运行deck

howto.what_en: When asked to create a slideshow or presentation deck, Claude builds a navigable HyperFrames deck (discrete slides, fragments, hotspots, branching, presenter mode) rather than an MP4. It can also convert an existing page into such a deck.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user directly asks for a slideshow / slide show / HyperFrames slideshow. For adjacent requests (presentation, pitch deck, page conversion) it confirms before building.

say_en.text: Turn this product intro into a HyperFrames slideshow
say_en.note: Produces a navigable deck, not an MP4

say_en.text: Convert this page into slides, keeping its motion
say_en.note: Maps page motion to slide-to-slide camera moves

say_en.text: Make a 10-page pitch deck with hotspot branches
say_en.note: Builds a runnable deck with hotspots and branches
